name: generate_image
description: 🎨 Generate or edit AI images with Gemini, OpenAI, or xAI. Create pictures, artwork, infographics, visualizations. Edit existing images by providing a reference_image (stash ref, path, or URL). Use when user says 'generate an image', 'create a picture', 'make artwork', 'draw', 'visualize', 'edit this image', 'change the image'. PROVIDERS: Gemini (default) has Google Search grounding; OpenAI has best text rendering; xAI is fast and cheap. All 3 support image-to-image editing. Images save to stash for email, print, canvas, PDF.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image to generate, or edit instructions when reference_image is provided. For generation: be specific about subject, colors, mood, composition. For editing: describe the changes to make. Example generation: 'A cozy coffee shop with warm lighting'. Example edit: 'Change the dog to a cat, keep everything else the same'.

reference_image.description: Source image to edit. Accepts: stash:// ref (e.g. stash://space_xxx/file_id), local file path, public URL, or base64 data URI. When provided, the tool EDITS this image based on the prompt instead of generating from scratch. All 3 providers (Gemini, OpenAI, xAI) support image editing.

provider.description: Image provider: 'gemini' (default, grounding for real-time data), 'openai' (GPT Image, best text/instruction following), 'xai' (grok-imagine, fast & cheap). Uses IMAGE_TOOL_PROVIDER from config if not specified.

aspect_ratio.description: Image shape: 'square' (1:1), 'landscape'/'wide' (16:9 cinematic), 'portrait' (9:16), or exact ratios. Do not use 21:9; xAI rejects it. OpenAI maps to closest size.

image_size.description: Resolution/Quality: '1K' (fast/low), '2K' (default/medium), '4K' (best/high). For OpenAI gpt-image-2, also maps to larger size dimensions where supported.

use_grounding.description: 🌐 GEMINI ONLY: Enable Google Search grounding for REAL-TIME data. Use for: weather infographics, stock charts, current events, sports scores. Gemini searches web first, then generates accurate imagery.

style.description: Art style: photorealistic, anime, watercolor, oil painting, sketch, digital art, 3D render, pixel art, comic book, impressionist, minimalist, cyberpunk, fantasy, infographic

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid: 'blurry, low quality, text, watermark, distorted'

context_data.description: GEMINI ONLY: Data from other Jarvis tools to incorporate. Example: weather data, crypto prices. Chain tools: get data first, pass here.

transparent.description: OPENAI ONLY: Enable transparent background. Works with png/webp output on gpt-image-1.5/1/1-mini. gpt-image-2 does not currently support transparent backgrounds.

output_format.description: OPENAI ONLY: Output format. 'png' (default, lossless), 'jpeg' (faster, smaller), 'webp' (modern, good compression). Transparent requires png/webp.

n.description: XAI ONLY: Number of images to generate (1-10). Only first image is saved to stash; all returned in response.

save.description: Save to stash for use with email/print/canvas/PDF (default: true)
